name: green_anaconda
description: Adult female green anaconda (Eunectes murinus), full length side view in a gentle S, facing right, mouth closed: thick heavy olive #5f7a2e body, darker back #4a5f22, pale yellow-olive belly scutes #c9c06a, big black oval back spots, smaller black flank spots with yellow centres, small head barely wider than the neck with the eye and nostril on top, orange-tan black-edged stripe back from the eye, small mean eye with round pupil, no fangs. Anchor centre, ~1000x200 (x -510..500); head at about (+460,-30). Single solid silhouette (safe for silhouette + rim).
